Deleting a highlight now removes its whole section from the book note, including what you wrote under it.

- Before this, deleting a highlight left its quote in the book note whenever something was written under it. The quote stayed with no highlight behind it, so it lost its highlight color and its **Open passage** link no longer led anywhere.
- Now the quote and the writing under it, up to the next quote or heading, are removed together. Headings and text after them stay. **Undo** restores the highlight, the quote, and the writing.
- To keep the old behavior, turn on **Keep writing of deleted highlights** under Book notes in settings. Sections you wrote under then stay when their highlight is deleted.
- A section whose quote you edited still stays when its highlight is deleted.

Quotes left behind by earlier versions are not removed automatically. Delete them by hand.

Requires Obsidian desktop 1.14.4 or newer. Runtime verification covers Linux.
